children: Chevron has inked a deal to spend $7 billion in Venezuelan oil fields over the next five years.
It adds two new undeveloped heavy oil fields to the company's JV with state-run Petróleos de Venezuela.

The expansion plan-a win for the Trump administration, which has prompted oil companies to invest there-will double Chevron's output over five years to 600,000 barrels per day. Its production rate there is up some 15% this year.
Chevron shares inched higher in premarket trading.
